newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says reviews Spie Batignolles buyout.
newsitem.headline: EU says reviews Spie Batignolles buyout.

text.p: The European Commission said on Thursday it was starting a routine probe into the acquisition of French construction firm Spie Batignolles SA by its employees alongside Amec Plc, a British construction and engineering group.
Spie is currently a unit of diversified engineering group Schneider SA.

Schneider said last month it had accepted an offer by Spie employees and Amec to buy out Batignolles along with its holding in Spie-Trindel. This second aspect was not mentionned in a Commission statement published in the European Union's Official Journal.
Under the terms of the agreement, after six years Amec would have the right to buy out all of Spie Batignolles shares, Schneider said.

The Commission's statement said the deal was notified for clearance under the EU's merger rules on January 3. It has one month to clear it or start an in-depth probe if concerned about the impact on competition. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
